summary: Pre-Vote update modelled (MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED); harness rebased, 20 fresh traces validated by TLC; model checking found MC-1: a Pre-Vote round started while Candidate survives leader establishment and its quorum makes the new Leader start a real election.
validation_limits: All TLC campaigns are bounded (3 nodes, MaxTerm 2, MaxLogIndex 4, counters) and most were stopped by the 30-minute budget with a non-empty queue: LIMITED_COVERAGE, not proof.
Trace harness drives the real Engine; RaftCore tick decision, rate limit and response correlation are exercised only by the passing t12_pre_vote integration tests and by code reading.
Reproduction (Part 4) was not executed in this run; MC-1 is backed by a TLC counterexample over the complete MCNext and by a validated real-Engine trace whose follow-up call trips a debug assertion.
Pre-vote grant accumulation without quorum is unreachable in the 3-voter uniform MC seed (canary budget-limited); it is covered by the joint-configuration trace only.

findings.title: Stale Pre-Vote round survives leader establishment and makes the new Leader start a real election
findings.cause: Engine.pre_candidate is cleared only by do_elect and become_following; pre_elect runs beside a live candidacy (the tick skips only Leaders) and establish_leader/become_leader keep the round, so handle_pre_vote_resp later calls elect() on the established Leader.
findings.trigger: With Pre-Vote enabled (or trigger().elect(true)), a Candidate starts a Pre-Vote round for T+1, a delayed term-T grant makes it Leader, then the round's granted pre-vote responses reach quorum.
findings.consequence: A freshly elected Leader bumps its term and becomes Candidate while its term-T leader object remains; try_leader_handler's debug assertion leader.committed_vote >= state.vote fails (observed on the real Engine), contradicting the Pre-Vote contract of not disrupting a healthy leader.

premises: Pre-Vote is enabled for the tick (Config::enable_pre_vote or RuntimeConfigHandle::pre_vote) or requested via trigger().elect(true) while the node is Candidate.
For the timer path, the delayed term-T vote response arrives after the election timer fired and within the vote RPC timeout (election_timeout_min).
